Below is a minimal description of the problem followed by two *SEARCH/REPLACE* edits against `src/resources/filters/quarto-pre/panel-tabset.lua` that will correctly carry through any `.nav-fill` or `.nav-justified` class from your tabset container into the underlying Bootstrap `<ul>` element.

1. In the current code, classes like `nav-fill` sit on the outer `<div>` and never make it into the `<ul class="nav nav-tabs">`.  
2. We fix this by (a) changing the `render_tabset()` call so that it passes the container’s `attr.classes` into `ulAttribs`, and (b) updating `bootstrapTabs().ulAttribs` so that it adds any `"nav-fill"` or `"nav-justified"` that it finds.

With these two changes in place, any time you write

```markdown
:::{.panel-tabset .nav-fill}
## A
## B
:::
```

the generated HTML will correctly be:

```html
<ul class="nav nav-tabs nav-fill" role="tablist">…
```

which restores full Bootstrap 5 support for `nav-fill` (and also handles `nav-justified`).
